title_en: The Stance of Ibn Taymiyya and Scholars Regarding Essential and Attributive Divine Attributes (Part 2)
description_en: The stance of Ibn Taymiyya and Sunni scholars regarding essential and attributive divine attributes, Part 2. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: Part two of the analysis regarding the theological positions of Ibn Taymiyya and Sunni scholars on divine attributes.
